claims.body: On physicality, Ottawa sits 2nd of 32, at the bruising end of the scale. Nashville is 29th, at the finesse end.

OTT.head: A big edge for Ottawa
OTT.body: Ottawa has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Nashville’s only real way in is a penalty kill that holds up, and it would need a near-perfect night.

NSH.head: A steep climb for Nashville
NSH.body: Ottawa has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Nashville could still pull it off if its penalty kill holds up, but it might need a miracle.
